name: agile
summary: For the product team already running scrum: planning, refinement, review, retro. The record's streams were named in this shape from the start — this pack makes the ceremonies explicit and puts the product owner's words where the product owner reads.
law: Words change. The contract does not: paths, file names, statuses, command names, exit codes, and diagnostic codes are identical in every pack. The sixteen statutes are recorded verbatim and are never re-voiced.

01-document.gloss: the backlog sharpened into sprint-ready work

02-compose.gloss: the sprint increment, built and kept shippable

03-demonstrate.gloss: the review, the acceptance, the release

04-govern.gloss: the retro loop closed: monitor, measure, improve

streams.01-document/01-discover: [Finding] an idea or problem enters the backlog, before refinement exists · producer: anyone on the team → consumer: 02-refine
streams.01-document/02-refine: [Finding] backlog refinement — sharpen, size, order · producer: product owner + team → consumer: 04-plan
streams.01-document/03-validate: [Grounding] spikes and assumption tests before the sprint commits — validate cheap, before code · producer: discovery work → consumer: a validated backlog item
streams.01-document/04-plan: [Grounding] sprint planning — the sprint goal, what enters · producer: product owner + team → consumer: 02-compose/01-build
streams.02-compose/01-build: [Rising] the increment, built tests-first · producer: refined tickets + compose → consumer: 02-integrate
streams.02-compose/02-integrate: [Rising] keep it shippable — merged, green, reviewed by peers · producer: 01-build → consumer: 01-demo
streams.02-compose/03-enhance: [Nurturing] improvements pulled from sprint-review feedback into the sprint · producer: demo feedback → consumer: 01-build
streams.02-compose/04-maintain: [Nurturing] bugfixes and debt, never starved · producer: incidents, retro actions → consumer: 01-build
streams.03-demonstrate/01-demo: [Nurturing] the sprint review — working software, to stakeholders · producer: 02-integrate → consumer: 02-accept
streams.03-demonstrate/02-accept: [Nurturing] acceptance criteria met, the product owner signs · producer: 01-demo → consumer: 03-release
streams.04-govern/01-monitor: [Nurturing] production tells the truth · producer: 04-deploy → consumer: 02-measure
streams.04-govern/02-measure: [Leaving] outcomes against the sprint goal — outcomes only, never person-scores · producer: 01-monitor → consumer: 03-retrospect
streams.04-govern/03-retrospect: [Leaving] the retrospective — the ceremony of learning · producer: the whole team → consumer: 04-improve
streams.04-govern/04-improve: [Leaving] retro actions land here, each with an owner · producer: 03-retrospect → consumer: next 02-refine — the loop closes

gateQuestions.GQ-1: What does this story deliver, in one sentence anyone at sprint review can verify?
gateQuestions.GQ-2: What evidence proves each acceptance criterion actually ran?
gateQuestions.GQ-3: What is the biggest risk to this story landing this sprint — and its mitigation?
gateQuestions.GQ-4: What did you deliberately leave out of this sprint?

glossary.sprint planning: 01-document/04-plan — the sprint goal and what enters
glossary.the increment: 02-compose — what the sprint is building, kept shippable
glossary.peer review: inside 02-compose/02-integrate — merged and green is not enough, read by a peer
glossary.acceptance sign: 03-demonstrate/02-accept — the product owner signs when criteria are met
glossary.definition of done: the deliver gate — G1 spec complete, G2 score ≥ 60, G3 grill pass, G4 a proof that exists
glossary.retro: 04-govern/03-retrospect — the ceremony of learning; actions land in 04-improve
glossary.sprint goal outcomes: 04-govern/02-measure — outcomes against the goal, never person-scores
glossary.story (docodego type): a linked document in 01-document/02-refine — rolls up to an epic; not the scrum story, which this pack calls a ticket
glossary.ticket: a unit — the folder with spec.md, grill.md, score.md, proofs.md, delivered.md
glossary.velocity: not tracked here; 04-govern/02-measure records outcomes, not points
